// diagnostic

E1016

`#Inline(Always) fn` is `#Scrub`, and a `#Scrub` routine stays a call

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` is `#Scrub`, and a `#Scrub` routine stays a call

Why

A `#Scrub` routine reveals a fixed value as a public result, and only its own call keeps the value fixed up to that result

Fix

Drop `#Inline(Always)` from the `#Scrub` routine.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1016: tests/ui/inline_always_scrub.stderr.

Error [jet.InlineAlwaysScrub]: `redact` is `#Scrub`, so `#Inline(Always)` cannot expand it
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_scrub.jet:4:3
    |
  4 | #[Inline(Always), Scrub(PII)]
    |   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `#Scrub` routine reveals a fixed value as a public result, and only its own call keeps that value fixed up to the result; an inlined copy would let the fixed value flow on into the caller's code.
 Fix: Drop `#Inline(Always)`; a `#Scrub` routine stays a call.
